faq.q: What have condos in Coquitlam West sold for?
faq.a: 389 condos sold in Coquitlam West at a median of $620,000, with the middle half between $509,900 and $728,000.

items.t: 37 houses sold in Coquitlam West at a median of $1,650,000 (middle half $1,544,000 to $1,918,000). A typical house in Coquitlam West spent 36 days on the market and closed at 95.7% of the asking price.
In Coquitlam West, townhomes sold at a median of $938,950 across 46 sales, and the middle half closed between $799,225 and $1,024,975. The median townhome sat 36 days and sold for 99.0% of list.
Coquitlam West: 389 condos sold at a median of $620,000, with the middle half between $509,900 and $728,000. The median condo took 27 days to sell and closed at 97.5% of list.

13 duplexes sold in Coquitlam West at a median of $1,275,000 (middle half $1,239,900 to $1,400,000). A typical duplex in Coquitlam West spent 49 days on the market and closed at 97.6% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Coquitlam West compares with the rest of Coquitlam

items.t: Of 20 Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Coquitlam West ranks 9th highest at $1,650,000; the range is $984,000 (Meadow Brook) to $2,000,000 (Harbour Place). Central Coquitlam ($1,564,000) sits just below and Harbour Chines ($1,668,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Coquitlam West have the 5th highest median of 11 Coquitlam sub-areas, $938,950. Central Coquitlam is lowest at $617,500 and Westwood Plateau highest at $1,132,500. Eagle Ridge CQ ($873,250) sits just below and Scott Creek ($1,049,900) sits just above.

Of 8 Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Coquitlam West ranks third highest at $620,000; the range is $426,250 (Central Coquitlam) to $695,000 (New Horizons). North Coquitlam ($600,000) sits just below and Westwood Plateau ($656,500) sits just above.

Duplexes in Coquitlam West have the second lowest median of 3 Coquitlam sub-areas, $1,275,000. Central Coquitlam is lowest at $1,150,000 and Maillardville highest at $1,285,000. Central Coquitlam ($1,150,000) sits just below and Maillardville ($1,285,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Coquitlam West (median 2025) and houses the oldest (median 1966), a gap of 59 years.
